description: Sen4AgriNet is the National Observatory of Athens team's Sentinel-2 crop-classification and segmentation benchmark. It combines satellite observations with farmer-declared crop labels and parcel identifiers, using a harmonised crop taxonomy. Published configurations cover Catalonia in 2019 and 2020 and France in 2019. NetCDF files contain spectral-band time series, dates, crop masks and parcel masks; a documented PyTorch loader produces selected-band tensors and aggregated temporal windows. The author's public Hugging Face dataset card states MIT, with original LPIS sources under Open Data Commons Attribution. A limitation is that the hosted card leaves train-validation-test splits to users, while GitHub links optional scenario files; these choices must be fixed before comparison. The hosted viewer is disabled because its loader requires code execution. Sen4AgriNet can calibrate agricultural maps for irrigation and food-supply simulations, complementing CY-Bench (data-cy-bench-subnational-crop-yield-benchmark). Its 2022 paper describes the benchmark. The earlier rejection excluded reusable agricultural benchmarks under a narrower rule. No data or loader was downloaded or executed.
